description: On the green tabletop there’s a small white blocky model on a rectangular base, with several upright pillar pieces around it. The left hand reaches in over the base, touches and grips one pillar-like piece near the left side as a left-hand object, lifts it upward and then moves it leftward off the base to set it down beside the model, while the right hand stays resting on the base as a right-hand object.
